tool.name: Summarize DANTE_TIR output
tool.command: mkdir -p output_dir && dante_tir_summary.R -g '$tir_gff' -f '$reference_fasta' -o output_dir --threads \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} && if [ -f output_dir/report.html ]; then cp output_dir/report.html '$html_report'; fi && mkdir -p ${html_report.extra_files_path} && if [ -d output_dir ]; then cp -r output_dir/* ${html_report.extra_files_path}/; fi && cd output_dir && if ls *_all.fasta 1> /dev/null 2>&1; then cat *_all.fasta > '$all_representative_elements'; else touch '$all_representative_elements'; fi && if ls *multiplicity3plus.fasta 1> /dev/null 2>&1; then cat *multiplicity3plus.fasta > '$multiplicity3plus_elements'; else touch '$multiplicity3plus_elements'; fi && if ls *_representative_elements.csv 1> /dev/null 2>&1; then cat *_representative_elements.csv > '$representative_elements_csv'; else touch '$representative_elements_csv'; fi && zip -r summary_results.zip * && mv summary_results.zip '$output_archive'

param.name: tir_gff
param.label: DANTE_TIR GFF3 file
param.help: GFF3 file with DANTE_TIR final annotations

param.name: reference_fasta
param.label: Reference genome FASTA file
param.help: Genome assembly FASTA file corresponding to the TIR annotations

data.name: output_archive
data.label: DANTE_TIR - archive with complete summary on ${tir_gff.hid} and ${reference_fasta.hid}
data.help: ZIP archive containing all summary outputs including representative elements and clustering results

data.name: all_representative_elements
data.label: DANTE_TIR - All representative elements on ${tir_gff.hid} and ${reference_fasta.hid}
data.help: Concatenated FASTA file containing all representative elements from all superfamilies

data.name: multiplicity3plus_elements
data.label: DANTE_TIR - Representative elements with 3+ copies on ${tir_gff.hid} and ${reference_fasta.hid}
data.help: Concatenated FASTA file containing representative elements with multiplicity ≥3 from all superfamilies

data.name: representative_elements_csv
data.label: DANTE_TIR - Representative elements CSV (concatenated) on ${tir_gff.hid} and ${reference_fasta.hid}
data.help: Concatenated CSV file with detailed information about representative elements from all superfamilies

data.name: html_report
data.label: DANTE_TIR - summary report on ${tir_gff.hid} and ${reference_fasta.hid}
data.help: HTML report summarizing TIR transposon annotations and clustering results

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool generates a comprehensive summary of DANTE_TIR results, including clustering analysis and representative element identification. It processes the GFF3 output from DANTE_TIR along with the reference genome to create detailed reports and representative sequence libraries.
**Inputs**
1. **DANTE_TIR GFF3 file**: Final annotations from DANTE_TIR containing identified TIR transposon elements 2. **Reference genome FASTA file**: The genome assembly used for the original DANTE_TIR analysis
**Outputs**
1. **HTML Report**: Interactive summary report containing: - Overview of identified TIR transposon superfamilies - Clustering analysis results - Statistical summaries and visualizations - Representative element information
2. **Complete Results Archive (ZIP)**: Contains all output files for download
3. **All Representative Elements (concatenated)**: Single FASTA file containing all representative elements from all superfamilies (concatenated from `*_all.fasta` files)
4. **Multiplicity 3+ Elements (concatenated)**: Single FASTA file containing representative elements with multiplicity ≥3 from all superfamilies (concatenated from `*multiplicity3plus.fasta` files). This is suitable for building custom repeat libraries.
5. **Representative Elements CSV (concatenated)**: Single CSV file with detailed information about representative elements from all superfamilies (concatenated from `*_representative_elements.csv` files)
**Method**
The tool performs the following analysis steps:
1. **Sequence Clustering**: Uses mmseqs2 to cluster DNA transposon sequences within each superfamily 2. **Representative Selection**: Identifies representative sequences for each cluster 3. **Statistical Analysis**: Calculates cluster sizes, multiplicities, and distribution statistics 4. **Report Generation**: Creates comprehensive HTML reports with visualizations 5. **Library Creation**: Generates FASTA libraries of representative elements for downstream analysis
**Requirements**
- Input GFF3 file must be from DANTE_TIR analysis - Reference FASTA file must match the coordinate system used in the GFF3 file
**Output Files Description**
- **CSV files**: Contain detailed information about representative elements including cluster sizes and sequence statistics - **FASTA files**: Provide sequences for representative elements, useful for building custom repeat libraries - **HTML report**: Offers interactive visualization and summary of the analysis results
**References**
For more information about DANTE_TIR and its summary functionality, see: https://github.com/kavonrtep/dante_tir
This tool is part of the RepeatExplorer suite for comprehensive repeat element analysis.
